name: HOTFIX (one commit, one line) — stop the live publication of the two P0 review pages: commit only `.vitepress/config.mts`
description:
## Why this is the top item

`.vitepress/config.mts` line 13 adds `srcExclude: ['features/workspaces-*-review.md', 'transformation/**']`. That line exists **only in the working tree** (`M .vitepress/config.mts, +1/-0`). `HEAD` still has no `srcExclude`, so **every build served to the public right now still publishes**:
- `features/workspaces-container-routing-review.md` (827 lines, P0 vulnerability disclosure with `path:line` citations)
- `features/workspaces-settings-scope-review.md` (588 lines)
- everything under `transformation/`

Cards `07006e18` ("fix done") and `60917b9a` (disclose) both assume the exclusion is live. It is not — it is uncommitted. Measured 2026-11-24T14:5xZ by `ProjectManager` shift #14.

## The action (one human, ~2 minutes)

```
cd /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/docs
git add .vitepress/config.mts
git commit -m "docs: exclude internal review pages and transformation/ from the published site"
git push
```

Nothing else goes in this commit. Do **not** use `git commit -am` (the working tree has 62 changed files).

## Why it is safe
- One added line, zero page content changed. Revert = `git revert <sha>` (one line).
- `ignoreDeadLinks: true`, so removing pages cannot fail the build.
- No dependency on `npm`, on `docs/package-lock.json`, or on the content increment — that is why this is a separate, shippable slice.

## Acceptance / demo (5 minutes, no slides)
1. `git show --stat HEAD` → 1 file changed, +1.
2. After the deploy finishes, open `/features/workspaces-container-routing-review` → **404**. Same for `-settings-scope-review`.
3. Site search for `P0-6` / `proxied apps are not authenticated` → **no result** (search index is rebuilt from `srcDir`).
4. Paste the commit sha and the 404 screenshots on this card.

## Not in this increment
`features/company-spaces.md` (untracked, fixes the live dead link at `features/index.md:34`) and the other 8 content files — those ship in `e27a5d03` after the truthfulness verdict. Publishing an unverified page is a worse trade than a dead link, which `ignoreDeadLinks` already tolerates.

## CORRECTED 2026-11-24 17:5xZ — DO NOT run the commit this card specifies

**Evidence** (`project_changes(scope="all", paths=[".vitepress/config.mts"], include_patch=true)`, run today):
the diff against `HEAD` is **+1/-0**, and the single added line is the sidebar entry
`{ text: 'Company files and coworking spaces', link: '/features/company-spaces' }`.

`srcExclude: ['features/workspaces-*-review.md', 'transformation/**']` (`config.mts:13`) and
`ignoreDeadLinks: true` (`:15`) **do not appear in the diff**, so they are **already in `HEAD`** —
committed, not working-tree-only. The premise of this card and of the last three shifts
("HEAD still publishes them") is **false**.

**Two consequences:**
1. No commit is needed to stop the publication of the two review pages at repository level.
2. Running this card's one-line instruction as written would be **harmful**: it commits the
   company-spaces nav entry while `features/company-spaces.md` (120 lines, verified present) is still
   **untracked** → a nav link pointing at a 404 for real users, and `ignoreDeadLinks: true` keeps the
   build green so nothing catches it.

**Residual risk is deployment, not version control:** whether the public site was rebuilt after the
`srcExclude` commit is unknown from here. Carried on `60917b9a` and step 0 of the new human runbook.

Closing as already satisfied. `.vitepress/config.mts` must still be committed, but **only together with
`features/company-spaces.md`** — see `e27a5d03`.
